offers_products.reason: Main offering is HSA/FSA/COBRA benefit administration; accounts are delivered as services, not goods or licensed software.

offers_services.reason: Administers HSAs, FSAs, HRAs, COBRA and commuter benefits for employers and members; custodian and account services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Individuals open and use HSAs; members choose, save, spend and invest through accounts and can open an HSA directly.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Employers, health plans, benefits advisors and state governments such as Louisiana buy benefits administration solutions.

recurring_revenue.reason: Ongoing HSA accounts, custodial balances, and multi-year employer administration contracts generate continuing fees and interchange revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Health benefit accounts and COBRA administration are tied to healthcare and mandated benefits; employers rarely drop them in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Small, recurring account fees and transactions; no large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from its owned technology platform, account custody and integrations, not mainly staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Clients include employers of all sizes, individual members and health plans; not mainly large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Technology and service platform with no plants or fleets; growth needs software and people, not heavy physical assets.

notes: Large-customer answer is uncertain: clients span employers of all sizes, health plans and advisors, plus individual account holders.
